rowText: With Hades running, ask 'How do I beat Megaera?' and check Show details: PASS if the Megaera note attaches with no 'no close match' line; FAIL if the line still shows. Library on the Deck is 2026.09.18, which is supposed to carry the corrected spelling.

verdictSentence: Asking about Megaera by the correct spelling now finds her own note cleanly, with no warning that nothing close was found -- the spelling fix mentioned in the library notes for 2026-09-18 appears to have landed.
notes: The plugin log for this ask carries no retrieval-specific line at all (see KB-TRANSPARENCY-01-retry3), so this verdict rests on what Show details shows on screen, not on a cross-check against the log.
